title: High-Fidelity Calculations
description: Formulas validated against modern standards (ISO 1302, ASME B5.50) with high floating-point precision and boundaries.

title: Engineering Notes & Formulas
description: Each calculator provides a full theoretical explanation, clear formula printouts, and real-world physical notes.

title: Dual Unit Systems
description: Simultaneous calculation outputs in Imperial (Inches, lb-ft, HP, SFM) and Metric (Millimeters, N·m, kW, m/min) systems.

title: Instant Client-Side Search
description: A unified sub-second search engine indexing calculators, materials, machine libraries, and topics instantly.

title: Responsive Layout
description: Elegant design built on a warm ivory aesthetic, rendering perfectly on iPads, smartphones, and shop-floor displays.

title: Extensible Architecture
description: Store all static configurations in clean, decoupled JSON files, making future database or login integrations a breeze.
